title: Patient Enquiry Follow-Up Automation
summary: Bring patient enquiries from web forms, WhatsApp, ads and missed calls into one queue, reply promptly with approved information, collect reports and route each enquiry to the right counsellor.

seo.title: Patient Enquiry Follow-Up Automation | VipraTech
seo.description: Capture hospital enquiries from web, WhatsApp, ads and calls, reply with approved content, collect reports and route them to the right counsellor.

problem.intro: Hospitals receive enquiries about surgeries, treatments and health check-up packages through website forms, WhatsApp, social ads, listing sites and phone calls. Many are never followed up, get a generic reply or wait days for a cost estimate, and the patient chooses another hospital. Counsellors spend time on unqualified enquiries while serious ones wait.

pain_points.title: Enquiries spread across channels
pain_points.detail: Forms, WhatsApp chats, ad leads and missed calls sit in different inboxes with no single owner.

pain_points.title: Slow first response
pain_points.detail: Enquiries that arrive in the evening or on Sunday wait until staff are back, by which time the patient has moved on.

pain_points.title: Estimate bottleneck
pain_points.detail: Patients want an indicative cost, but estimates depend on reports, insurance and room choice, and billing is busy.

pain_points.title: No tracking to outcome
pain_points.detail: Marketing cannot tell which channels lead to consultations and admissions, so budgets follow guesswork.

solution.overview: We build an enquiry follow-up system that brings every patient enquiry into one CRM queue, whether it starts on the website, WhatsApp, a social ad, a listing site or a missed call. A WhatsApp assistant replies promptly in the patient's language with approved information about the department, doctors and consultation process, and collects what the counsellor needs: procedure of interest, city, payment mode or insurer, preferred dates and existing reports. It offers OPD or teleconsultation slots and sends reminders. Counsellors receive a summary with the uploaded reports and send indicative estimates prepared by billing. The assistant never gives medical opinions or promises outcomes.
capabilities: Lead capture from website forms, WhatsApp, Meta and Google ad forms, listing sites and missed-call numbers
WhatsApp replies in English, Hindi and regional languages from an approved content library
Structured intake of procedure interest, city, insurer or cash, preferred dates and report uploads
OPD and teleconsultation booking with reminders
Counsellor routing by department, language and domestic or international enquiry
Channel-to-consultation and admission reporting for marketing

workflow.title: Capture
workflow.detail: Enquiries from every channel are de-duplicated by phone number and created as leads in the CRM.

workflow.title: Screen for urgency
workflow.detail: Messages that describe an emergency get immediate emergency guidance and a staff alert instead of an enquiry flow.

workflow.title: Acknowledge and collect
workflow.detail: The WhatsApp assistant replies with approved information and collects intake details and reports.

workflow.title: Route to a counsellor
workflow.detail: Qualified enquiries go to the right counsellor with a summary, and billing prepares any estimate.

workflow.title: Book and remind
workflow.detail: The assistant offers consultation slots, books them in the HIS and sends reminders.

workflow.title: Track outcomes
workflow.detail: Consultations, admissions and drop-offs are recorded against the source channel.

inputs: Approved content on departments, doctors and packages
Billing-approved package prices and estimate templates
outputs: Unified, de-duplicated enquiry queue in the CRM
Intake summaries with uploaded reports for counsellors
human_in_the_loop: Counsellors handle every qualified enquiry and send any cost estimate, which billing prepares. Clinicians review the medical content in the approved library, and the assistant hands over to staff on any clinical question.
integrations: CRM such as LeadSquared, Salesforce, Zoho or HubSpot
Meta and Google ad lead forms
guardrails: No medical opinions, diagnoses or outcome promises in any message
Prices shared only from billing-approved packages or counsellor estimates
Emergency phrases trigger emergency guidance and a staff alert
Opt-in respected and opt-outs honoured across channels
Patient-shared reports stored securely, with access limited to counsellors and doctors
compliance_notes: Health information shared by enquirers handled with consent and purpose limitation under the DPDP Act 2023.
SMS and calls follow TRAI commercial communication rules, and WhatsApp messages use approved templates with opt-in.
Content avoids outcome claims, consistent with the medical ethics and advertising norms that apply to healthcare providers.

pilot.scope: Enquiries for two or three elective services, such as orthopaedics, cataract surgery or health check-up packages, from website and WhatsApp channels.
deliverables: Approved content library for the pilot services

what_we_measure.how: Time from enquiry to first reply, compared with the month before the pilot.
Enquiries reaching a counsellor with procedure, city, payment mode and reports captured.
Consultations booked from pilot enquiries, tracked through the HIS.
Counsellor rating of summary usefulness on a sample of handovers.

faqs.q: Will the assistant answer medical questions?
faqs.a: No. It shares approved information about services, doctors and processes, and passes any clinical question to a counsellor or doctor. It never comments on a patient's condition or reports.
It can share fixed package prices your billing team has approved. Estimates that depend on reports, insurance or room choice are prepared by billing and sent by the counsellor.

faqs.q: Does it handle international patient enquiries?
faqs.a: Yes. International enquiries can go to your international patient desk with language, country and documents captured. Visa and medical travel paperwork stays with that team.

faqs.q: How do you keep messages compliant?
faqs.a: Messages come from an approved library reviewed by your marketing, legal and clinical teams. Opt-ins, opt-outs and TRAI rules for SMS and calls are applied automatically.
